description: This PHP file defines the KpiService class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It provides methods to get a KPI DAO, save a KPI with validation, transaction management, and exception handling. The class interacts with KPI entities and data access objects, facilitating business logic related to KPI management.

classes.name: KpiService
classes.description: Provides KPI-related business logic, including saving KPIs with validation and transaction management.

methods.name: getKpiDao
methods.description: Retrieves the KpiDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Saves a KPI entity after validating rating values and handling database transactions with error handling.
